bias: 'Here's the plan: Really though. There can't be setups after a move like this on either the long or the short side.' After the ES 7815-7820 / NQ sub-30200 rejection, Thursday was bloody — NQ a short all night, 623-656 gave way into the open, straight shot to 380-436, one failed reclaim of 623-656 (a LAAF of the IB high) was the excellent short, and after the bell NQ broke down in a big way with ES along for the ride (−100+ from Wednesday's AH high). The rally into the close on both was a gnarly trap. Happy to join any session downtrend on the short side; if 'shorting the hole' is a psychological block, take the day off without perfect discipline. Seller-exhaustion longs can be violent and lucrative but 99.9% of traders shouldn't bother. If the overnight turns into an uptrend, or we open on a true gap down and it's a gap-down buy, be long looking for a rally toward today's low. ES is far closer to reclaims than NQ.
wildcard: No long is safe on NQ below 29380-29436 — pops are rentals. ES: a correlated sell that blows out dispersion traders is coming soon ('perhaps tomorrow, perhaps not') — he's not buying knives on weakness. NQ tests the mettle of the dip buyers in 28944-28969 → 29038-29069 tonight/tomorrow; hard to imagine them bidding again looking up at that failure, and if nearly 3 months of buyers above let go it could get violent. Every downside spot is moderately weakened by this second failed attempt higher. Month-end Friday.
